{{Conflicting|this randomly chosen scenario in this segment of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' ride|the [[Skirmish over Naboo (Galactic Civil War)|Skirmish over Naboo]]|the [[Skirmish at Geonosis]] from the ride}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
[[File:StarTours-Coruscant.jpg|thumb|300px|A view of the battle from inside the StarSpeeder 1000]]
One year before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Convenient">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> an '''incident''' occurred above the orbit of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] capital, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where two fleets, one primarily composed of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] and [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC fighters]], and another composed of ships and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] formerly owned by the (then-defunct) [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], were in battle with each other. A [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]]&ndash;owned [[StarSpeeder 1000]], accidentally piloted by [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] who inadvertently replace the intended pilot [[AC-38/Legends|AC-38]], briefly got involved in the battle when trying to safely deliver a [[Unidentified Rebel spy|Rebel spy]] to a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] cell on Coruscant. Even though one of the ships was shot down and underwent atmospheric reentry, the city-planet's surface was unaffected by the battle.

==Behind the scenes==
The mission is based on a scenario from the ride ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'', which featured the use of the StarSpeeder 1000 [[Star Tours Flight 1401|ST-1401]]. Because of the nature of the ride, the incident above Coruscant is shown randomly, although it is always the last portion of the ride. In large part because of the random nature of the ride, the StarSpeeder 1000's flight number is not given in this article.

The scenario makes it ambiguous whether the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] and the Rebels were involved in the battle, which fleet each of them were using, or even if it was a real battle. The orbital battle was similar to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]' [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] from [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] and was likely designed to be an homage to it.
